lines.text: Do you know how a soap bubble works? It's a ball of air, wrapped in a skin of water much thinner than a hair.
That skin is a sandwich. A thin layer of water, held between two layers of soap that stop it drying out too fast.
The air inside pushes out equally in every direction, so the skin pulls into a sphere, the smallest shape that can hold it.
The colours come from light bouncing off the inside and the outside of the skin. As the skin gets thinner, the colours shift.
As the water drains down and dries out, the top turns dark, and then. Pop.
Orbi has bubbles too. Post one, everyone gets their own colour, and it's gone within 30 minutes.
